cover.coreProposition: Standing permission policy and occurrence authority should be separate governance objects: a reusable policy may route a future action to Allow, Ask or Never, but whenever the decision remains open, final authority must bind the concrete occurrence and be independently auditable.
cover.visualMetaphor: A reusable route marker guides many paths while one luminous action seal closes only a single path
cover.semanticObject: A branching route marker beside one distinct sealed action token
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with a calm reusable routing structure on the left and one concrete commitment token in sharp focus on the right
